anchors.statement: sc-lint must be a layered design.  w/ layers (lowest to highest):  a) sc-lint-types (shared types) and sc-lint-attribute (shared attributes)  b) independent cargo tools (i.e. sc-lint-boundary)  c) sc-lint cli which calls into (b)  d) just template (recommended just command layout w/ recommended mapping to (b) and (c) )
anchors.summary: Four layers: shared types/attributes, cargo tools, CLI, just template
anchors.scope: every phase-i change: architecture documentation, crate dependencies, CLI commands, and the adoption-kit just template
anchors.deterministic_check: cargo metadata --format-version 1 --no-deps: sc-lint-boundary, sc-lint-portability and sc-lint-runtime depend on no sc-lint-* crate outside sc-lint-schema, sc-lint-directives, sc-lint-analyzer-support, sc-lint-attributes; those (a) crates depend on no (b) or (c) crate; docs/architecture.md has a Layered Architecture section naming layers (a)-(d)

anchors.statement: I expect 'just test' to be managed and customized by the repo.  sc-lint supplies patterns and general helper functions
anchors.summary: Repo owns just test; sc-lint supplies patterns and helpers
anchors.scope: the adoption-kit just template, any sc-lint CLI test command, and any helper sc-lint ships for consumer test recipes
anchors.deterministic_check: git diff of the phase adds no consumer test orchestration to crates/sc-lint; the kit's test recipe is a consumer-editable pattern; any sc-lint addition for testing is a general helper the recipe calls
